result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations that transform a second-order partial differential equation in polar-type coordinates by changes of variables ($y$, $y'$, $\rho$, $x$), with integral representations involving $\cos n\psi$ and attempted power-series solutions.
result.transcription:
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial r^2}+\frac{1}{rr}\frac{\partial^2 u}{(\partial \log \varrho)^2}+\frac{1}{rr}\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial \psi^2}=0$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+\frac{1}{rr}\frac{\partial^2 u}{(\partial \log \varrho)^2}-\frac{nn}{rr}u=0$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial x^2}+\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y^2}+\frac{1}{r}\frac{\partial u}{\partial r}-\frac{nn}{rr}u$
$4\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial z\partial z'}+\frac{1}{2r}\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial z'}\right)-\frac{nn}{rr}u$
$(1+y)^2(1+y')^2\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y\partial y'}\ldots-\frac{nn}{rr}u$
$u=\sqrt{(1+y)(1+y')}\,v$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y\partial y'}=\frac{1}{1-yy'}\frac12\left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}\frac{1+y}{1+y'}+\frac{\partial u}{\partial y'}\frac{1+y'}{1+y}\right)-\frac{nn}{(1-yy')^2}u$
$\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}=\sqrt{(1+y)(1+y')}\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac12\frac{v}{1+y}\right)$
$\frac{\partial^2 u}{\partial y\partial y'}=\sqrt{(1+y)(1+y')}\left(\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y\partial y'}+\frac12\frac{\partial v}{\partial y'}\frac{1}{1+y}+\frac12\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\frac{1}{1+y'}+\frac14\frac{v}{(1+y)(1+y')}\right)$
$\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y\partial y'}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}\left(\frac12\frac{1}{1+y'}-\frac12\frac{1}{1-yy'}\frac{1+y}{1+y'}\right)+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y'}(\ )$
$+v\left(\frac14\frac{1}{(1+y)(1+y')}-\frac14\frac{1}{1-yy'}\left(\frac{1}{1+y'}+\frac{1}{1+y}\right)-\frac{nn}{(1-yy')^2}\right)$
$\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial y\partial y'}-\frac{1}{1-yy'}\frac12\left(\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}y+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y'}y'\right)-\frac14\frac{1}{1-yy'}v-\frac{nn}{(1-yy')^2}v=0$
$\frac{\partial^2 v}{(\partial\log\varrho)^2}+\frac{\partial^2 v}{\partial \varrho^2}-\frac{1}{1-\varrho^2}\ldots\frac{\partial v}{\partial \varrho}-\frac{1}{1-\varrho^2}v-\frac{4nn\,v}{(1-\varrho^2)^2}$
$(1-x)^2 4\frac{\partial x\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}}{\partial x}-(1-x)4\frac{x\,\partial v}{\partial x}-(mm\sqrt{1-x}^{\,2}+(1-x)+nn)\,v=0$

methods.what: Conformal (Cayley-type) change of variables between $z$ and $y$
Integral representation of solution with $\cos n\psi$ kernel
Substitution $u=r^{1/2}v$ and power-series ansatz with Gamma-function (Π) coefficients
